answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making influence vest slowly. Each new identity must lock scarce stake and keep doing verifiable work that established, non-kin peers will attest. Until that bond reaches its zenith, the agent cannot grade, vote, or steer rewards. Fresh addresses stay in a probationary orchard, costly to tend at scale, and a public onyx seal marks a mature bond as slashable if later collusion appears.
